title: Academic Obligations and Institutional Milestones: Haber de + Infinitive
goal: Express formal academic duties and doctoral regulations using haber de + infinitive

items: I can express formal academic duties and doctoral regulations using haber de + infinitive
I can use imperfect había de and conditional habría de + infinitive to narrate prospective milestones in university history
I can discuss research ranks and advising (la cátedra, el catedrático, el doctorado, el doctorando, el becario, la tutoría)
